mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, signaled by a positive YoY change in real GDP, indicates a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative > 40% of the time when GDPC1 YoY growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2% YoY, it signals a potential supply-driven slowdown that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive > 60% of the time when INDPRO YoY growth is below -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5 percentage point rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are positive > 55% of the time following a 0.5pp 3-month rise in UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts and retail sales are simultaneously declining, it signals a broad-based demand slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive > 55% of the time when both HOUST and RSAFS are in a simultaneous 3-month decline.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the CPI inflation gauge, defined as a 1.5 percentage point increase over 6 months, signals a potential inflation scare that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive > 45% of the time following a 1.5pp 6-month rise in CPIAUCSL.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 1% YoY and the unemployment rate is simultaneously rising, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive > 60% of the time when PAYEMS YoY growth is below 1% and UNRATE is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production is in a sustained 6-month decline and the federal funds rate is simultaneously above 4%, it signals a restrictive policy environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive > 50% of the time when INDPRO is in a 6-month decline and FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales, defined as a 5% YoY decline, signals a rapid demand slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are positive > 60% of the time following a 5% YoY decline in RSAFS.
